Messages.Body:
I have Smudge in play. Smudge has one of my temptations on him. He has
0 blood and thus hunts. Someone plays foul blood at qui and he gains
zero. Temptation has zero counters.

1) May i burn 0 counters of Smudge to untap and hunt again?

2) If yes, may I do this more than once with the same temptation,
Smudge still having 0 blood? Or would I need multiple Temptations?

Messages.Author: witness1
Messages.Body:
On Aug 28, 3:17 pm, Blooded Sand <sandm...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I have Smudge in play. Smudge has one of my temptations on him. He has
> 0 blood and thus hunts. Someone plays foul blood at qui and he gains
> zero. Temptation has zero counters.
>
> 1) May i burn 0 counters of Smudge to untap and hunt again?

No. You must have at least one counter to use a temptation.

> 2) If yes, may I do this more than once with the same temptation,
> Smudge still having 0 blood? Or would I need multiple Temptations?

"During your minion phase" means once per minion phase (per
temptation).

-witness1

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
witness1 wrote:
> On Aug 28, 3:17 pm, Blooded Sand <sandm...@gmail.com> wrote:
>> I have Smudge in play. Smudge has one of my temptations on him. He has
>> 0 blood and thus hunts. Someone plays foul blood at qui and he gains
>> zero. Temptation has zero counters.
>>
>> 1) May i burn 0 counters of Smudge to untap and hunt again?
>
> No. You must have at least one counter to use a temptation.

No, zero "equals or exceeds" zero. So if Smudge has zero, you need have only
zero counters to use Temptation.

>> 2) If yes, may I do this more than once with the same temptation,
>> Smudge still having 0 blood? Or would I need multiple Temptations?
>
> "During your minion phase" means once per minion phase (per
> temptation).

Correct.
